title: Integrability of the integrands of τ(M, θ, ξ)
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (k-vectors, `NVector`) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ. Write H := Hᵏ = μHE[k].
(a) For every compact K ⊆ U and every k-covector b, the function x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(b) is H-integrable on M ∩ K.
(b) For every continuous k-covector field ω : ℝ^P → Λᵏ(ℝ^P) with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U, the function x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) is H-integrable on M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)) (b : Covector (Eucl P) k), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x b) (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ ∀ ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → tsupport ω ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x (ω x)) M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))
